items.title: Rescuers scramble for survivors with 180 dead in Colombia earthquake
items.description: Colombia experienced a number of aftershocks on Tuesday, as efforts continued to free survivors trapped in rubble and buildings.

items.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
items.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

items.title: Inside the Secret Service 'shell game' to hide US presidents in plain sight
items.description: Elaborate deception operations and decoys are often used to deceive potential threats to the US president.

items.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
items.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed seven people - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

items.title: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health
items.description: Trump said Robert Gilman, who was arrested in 2022, was released on a humanitarian basis, after he had reportedly been in a catatonic-like state.

items.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
items.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

items.title: France bans unsolicited telemarketing calls
items.description: Cold calling is coming to an end in France, with one consumer group calling the ban a "small revolution".

items.title: Former judge removed by Orbán elected Hungarian president
items.description: Since taking office in early May, the new Hungarian government has lost no time dismantling Viktor Orbán's legacy.

items.title: Luigi Mangione murder trial to have anonymous jury and overflow seating
items.description: The judge overseeing the state murder trial has set out some rules for public access, but other questions remain about the high-profile case.

items.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
items.description: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

items.title: Thailand suspends new gun permits after mass shooting
items.description: Authorities promise tough new laws in the country, which has high levels of firearms ownership.

items.title: Libyan authorities battle big blaze at major oil refinery
items.description: Monday's drone strike on the Zawiya refinery was the third such incident in two days.
